label: Copy-phase late echo of h/e/0
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter steps), and only from roughly the 5th recalled position on (recall_idx >= 4; the firing rate climbs with t and peaks at the final steps of long L=8-9 sequences). It is token-selective on the fed-back input: h carries about 56% of activation mass, e 19%, 0 17%, z about 3%, and other tokens contribute almost nothing. The strongest activations (near max) are h or e inputs late in long sequences. The predicate catches about 82% of activations and 90% of mass, but precision is only about 0.43: many late copy-phase h/e/0 inputs stay below threshold, and adding to_go or prev_tok conditions did not cleanly separate them. Does not fire on original-phase occurrences of these tokens or on early copy positions.
